test_melspectrograml1loss: test MelSpectrogramL1Loss by computing L1 loss on mel spectrograms of two audio tensors
test_multiscalemelspectrogramloss: test MultiScaleMelSpectrogramLoss by computing multi-scale mel spectrogram loss between two audio tensors
test_mrstftloss: test MRSTFTLoss by computing multi-resolution STFT loss between two audio tensors
test_sisnr: test SISNR loss by computing scale-invariant signal-to-noise ratio between two audio tensors
test_stftloss: test STFTLoss by computing single-resolution STFT loss between two audio tensors
